history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—there are no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me fix this?

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I need to identify your account to check your line status and provide the correct support.

Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the problem.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently Active, which means there are no suspensions or contract issues blocking your service.

To help diagnose why you have no service (no bars, nothing loads, and can't send picture messages), could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? For example, do you see an airplane icon, "No SIM," or any other symbols?

This will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
I see an airplane icon at the top, and it says 'No Signal.' There are no signal bars, just the airplane symbol and 'Data Enabled.'

The airplane icon means Airplane Mode is enabled, which turns off all wireless connections—including cellular service. That’s why you have no signal and can’t send messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once it’s off, wait a few seconds to see if your signal bars return. Let me know if you see your signal come back or if you still have issues after turning off Airplane Mode.
Airplane mode is now off, but I still don't see any signal bars. It still says 'No Service' at the top.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still see “No Service,” the next step is to check your SIM card status, as issues with the SIM can also cause a complete loss of service.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it says:
- Active
- Missing
- Locked (PIN or PUK required)
- Any other message

This will help me guide you to the right solution.
My SIM card status says 'Active.' What should I try next?

Thank you for confirming your SIM card is active. Since Airplane Mode is off and your SIM is active but you still have no service, the next step is to check your phone’s network settings—specifically the APN (Access Point Name) settings, which are required for your phone to connect to our network.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if you see any errors or if the APN/MMSC fields are blank or incorrect. If you’re unsure, just let me know what you see, and I’ll guide you through the next steps.
My APN settings show 'fast.telecom.net' as the APN name, but the status says 'Not set.' The MMSC URL is 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc.' What should I do next?

Thank you for sharing your APN details. Since the APN status says "Not set," this could be causing your service issue. The best next step is to reset your APN settings to the default values.

Please reset your APN settings on your phone. After resetting, you’ll need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you’ve completed both steps, and if your service returns or if you still see “No Service.”

I've already reset the APN settings to defaults and rebooted my phone as instructed. The APN is now 'internet' and the MMSC URL is 'http://mms.carrier.com/mms'. After the reboot, I still see 'No Service' and have no signal bars.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular service ('No Service' and no signal bars) despite SIM being active, Airplane Mode off, and APN settings reset and correct. Standard troubleshooting did not resolve the issue.
